summary: Iteration 244: Tested Discover page redesign with GetKnownRootsBySearchString as primary data source. All 12 test cases passed. Search for 'embii' returns categorized results: Messages (145), Objects (60), Profiles (35), On-chain (37), Media (206). Tab switching works correctly. No bitfossil links found in rendered page. Profile navigation works. Show more button works.

minor.issue: 504 timeout errors on some IPFS image loads - external dependency, not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: Note: bitfossil references still exist in /app/frontend/src/utils/media.js, /app/frontend/src/components/archive/FossilCard.js, /app/frontend/src/components/archive/EtchToChain.js, and /app/frontend/src/pages/SingleObjectPage.js - but these are fallback/proxy logic that converts bitfossil URLs to local on-chain proxy, not direct links rendered to users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discover page redesign verified. Key findings: (1) Search for 'embii' returns 145 messages, 60 objects, 35 profiles, 37 on-chain items, 206 media items, (2) All 6 tabs work correctly (All, Messages, Objects, Profiles, On-chain, Media), (3) Tab switching correctly filters to show only that category, (4) 'All' tab shows all 5 sections together, (5) No bitfossil.org or bitfossil.com links in rendered page, (6) Profile navigation works - clicking profile navigates to /profile/{address}, (7) Show more button works - shows '125 remaining' and loads more items, (8) Search for 'test' also returns categorized results (157 messages, 60 objects, 37 profiles, 36 on-chain, 97 media), (9) Messages show text content, dates, and signer addresses, (10) On-chain items show file names (.jpg, .png), file sizes (KB), and dates, (11) Media items show filenames and type (image, video, audio, document), (12) Objects show images and names. Note: 504 errors from IPFS gateway are external dependency issues, not app bugs.
